entries.en: Stop the damn car!
No! Stop! Stop the killing!
It's not their fault! Shoot the girl and our deal is dead!
entries.en_m: It's not their fault! Shoot the guy and our deal is dead!
entries.ro: Nu e vina lor! Împușcă-o pe fată și afacerea noastră e moartă!
entries.ro_m: Nu e vina lor! Împușcă-l pe băiat și afacerea noastră e moartă!

entries.en: Come with us. You'll find out all you need to know on the way.
entries.ro: Vino cu noi. O să afli tot ce trebuie pe drum.

entries.en: Noted. But you don't have a vote here.
entries.ro: Notat. Dar aici nu ai vot.

entries.en: Hah! That's it. Got no fuckin' idea what this is about, but if you don't go with them I'm never talking to you again.
entries.ro: Ha! Asta e. Habar n-am despre ce dracu' e vorba, dar dacă nu mergi cu ei, nu-ți mai vorbesc niciodată.

entries.en: Finally! Somethin' that isn't a complete snorefest. Could binge-watch this all day if I had some popcorn…
entries.ro: În sfârșit! Ceva care nu e un somnifer total. Aș sta toată ziua la asta dacă aș avea popcorn…

entries.en: Well, this one time Rachel is right – we can't stay here.
entries.ro: Păi, de data asta Rachel are dreptate – nu putem sta aici.

entries.en: They're here to kill you!
We take her with us.
Ah, no thanks. Just be on my way, now.
entries.en_m: No thanks. Just be on my way, now.
entries.ro: Nu, mulțumesc. Îmi văd de drum acum.

entries.en: Ugh, wastin' time here!
Please? I need you. Really.
entries.ro: Te rog? Am nevoie de tine. Chiar am.

entries.en: Answer's no.
Why do you need me? Why so badly?
entries.ro: De ce mă vrei? Și de ce atât de tare?

entries.en: Now can we go?
Want me to come... to come with you?
entries.en_m: You wa-- you want me to come with you?
entries.ro: Vrei să vin... să vin cu tine?
entries.ro_m: Tu vr-- vrei să vin cu tine?

entries.en: Heh, I need you.
Nobody and I mean nobody, will harm a hair on your head. I'm just uh, heh... borrowing you.
entries.ro: Nimeni, și zic nimeni, nu-ți cade un fir de păr din cap. Doar că, ăă, heh... te împrumut.

entries.en: What the hell is this?
V.
Josh Stephenson. But you probably knew that already…
entries.ro: Josh Stephenson. Dar probabil știai deja…

entries.en: Your... associate – what was his name?
It's OK. You don't need to tell me. My name is Joshua Stephenson.
entries.ro: E OK. Nu trebuie să-mi spui. Mă numesc Joshua Stephenson.

entries.en: Aaaand your... associate – what was his name?
entries.ro: Șiiii asociatul tău... cum îl cheamă?

entries.en: Bill Jablonsky. Ring a bell?
Sadly, yes.
"Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom!"
entries.ro: „Învață-ne să ne numărăm zilele, ca să căpătăm o inimă înțeleaptă!”

entries.en: Already ID'd him. Bill Jablonsky.
Wait a sec, you're V? Eh, I heard o' you!
entries.ro: Stai puțin, tu ești V? Păi, am auzit de tine!

entries.en: Well I want to give her a job.
entries.en_m: Well I want to give him a job.
entries.ro: Păi, vreau să-i dau un job.

entries.en: Agh! Christ on a stick…
Gotta object, strongly.
Fuck! Brake, I said! Brake!
Stay close, I'm going to blow the motherfucker to bits myself!
entries.ro: Stai aproape, îl fac eu praf pe nenorocitul ăla!

entries.en: This is it, let's go!
First, gonna tell me what the hell's going on.
entries.en_m: First you're gonna tell me what the hell is going on.
entries.ro: Mai întâi, o să-mi spui ce naiba se întâmplă.

entries.en: The fuck are you doing? Stop!
NCPD! Stay where you are! And get that goddamn semi outta here!
entries.ro: NCPD! Stai pe loc! Și scoate naiba semiremorca aia de-aici!

entries.en: Right, let's just all shoot holes in each other.
entries.ro: Bine, hai să ne facem sită unii pe alții.

entries.en: For crying out loud, fuck! We can't leave her here! Media vultures'll be here any minute!
entries.en_m: For crying out loud, fuck! We can't leave him here! Media vultures'll be here any minute!
entries.ro: Doamne, futu-i! Nu o putem lăsa aici! Vulturii de la presă o să fie aici în orice clipă!
entries.ro_m: Doamne, futu-i! Nu-l putem lăsa aici! Vulturii de la presă o să fie aici în orice clipă!

entries.en: Gregor? Busted an attempted hit on my guy…
entries.ro: Gregor? Am stricat un atentat la omul meu…

entries.en: Vasquez! Shoot!
What?!
You're outta your fuckin' mind!
entries.ro: Ești ieșit din minți, pula mea!

entries.en: Hey, another word from you and I'm callin' the studio. Don't make me ruin your career.
entries.ro: Hei, mai scoți un cuvânt și sun la studio. Nu mă face să-ți distrug cariera.

entries.en: Hhmm... What's your name?
We can't take her, out of the question. She's way too big a threat.
entries.en_m: We can't take him, out of the question. He's way too big a threat.
entries.ro: Nici vorbă s-o luăm. E o amenințare prea mare.
entries.ro_m: Nici vorbă să-l luăm. E o amenințare prea mare.

entries.en: Screw this, I'm out.
Aahh... such a shame.
It's OK – go. Nobody's going to stop you.
entries.ro: E în regulă – du-te. Nimeni nu te oprește.

entries.en: Gonna tell me what it is you want from me?
entries.ro: Îmi spui ce vrei de la mine?

entries.en: Can't say the same about you.
entries.ro: Nu pot zice același lucru despre tine.

entries.en: All right. I'll go with you.
I'm not goin' anywhere.
Ugh, move it. We're running late.
Yeah. One cazh.
Loo-- I can explain, just... don't go! I... I need you.
entries.ro: Loo-- pot să explic, doar... nu pleca! Am nevoie de tine.

entries.en: You're insane if you think I'm getting in that car.
entries.ro: Ești nebun dacă crezi că mă urc în mașina aia.

entries.en: Haha, I just, ah... I, um... I really need you, please…
entries.ro: Haha, doar că, ah... eu, ăă... chiar am nevoie de tine, te rog…

entries.en: Ugh, ditch the bitch. We gotta go.
entries.en_m: Ugh, ditch the dick. We gotta go.
entries.ro: Ugh, scapă de curva aia. Trebuie să plecăm.
entries.ro_m: Ugh, scapă de boul ăla. Trebuie să plecăm.

entries.en: No. She's coming with us. She has to.
entries.en_m: No. He's coming with us. He has to.

entries.en: Aughh... Such a shame...
Lieutenant Vasquez, NCPD! Stop right there!
entries.ro: Locotenent Vasquez, NCPD! Stai pe loc!

entries.en: You're protecting a murderer!
Wait!
Drop it, or I shoot!
Want me to come... with you?
I'm not going anywhere.
What the hell you want from me?
entries.ro: Ce naiba vrei de la mine?

entries.en: Screw this, I'm out.
Why me?
Not about to go anywhere with you.
entries.ro: Nu mă duc nicăieri cu tine.

entries.en: Got no idea what's going on here.
entries.ro: N-am nicio idee ce se întâmplă aici.

entries.en: You're insane.
No thanks, I'm outta here.
V.
What's this about, tell me.
Bill Jablonsky.
[Get in] So be it, I'll go.
NCPD! Stop right there!
You fucking idiot!
[Get out]
Bill Jablonsky. No priors, but run a deep sweep just to be sure.
entries.ro: Bill Jablonsky. Fără antecedente, dar fă o verificare amănunțită, ca să fim siguri.

entries.en: This… this… what a fuckin' mess…
entries.ro: Asta… asta… ce căcat de mizerie…

entries.en: Told you drop it, dickhead…
Shoulda listened, shoulda fuckin' listened…
entries.ro: Trebuia să ascult, pula mea, trebuia să ascult…

entries.en: We're clear to go. Boys from the precinct'll mop up here.
entries.ro: Putem pleca. Băieții din secție fac curat aici.

entries.en: I'm gonna do it... I'm gonna fucking kill him!
entries.ro: Gata, o fac... Îl omor, pula mea!

entries.en: Olga? We've got a situation...
Somebody just tried to drop our star.
entries.ro: Cineva tocmai a încercat să ne omoare steaua.

entries.en: That psycho's out hiring professionals! It was only matter of time.
entries.ro: Nebunul ăla angajează profesioniști! Mai devreme sau mai târziu trebuia să se întâmple.

entries.en: 'Cause he's a fucking nutcase, that's why!
entries.ro: Că e un nebun de legat, pula mea, de-aia!

entries.en: What a cunt!
Thanks, I owe you. No patrol car and stay off the frequencies, too. Can't have this comin' back.
entries.ro: Mersi, rămân dator. Nicio mașină de patrulă și stai departe și de frecvențe. Asta nu trebuie să ajungă înapoi la noi.

entries.en: Out. Go. Now.
